build.reason: The supplied Autotools recipe builds the library and links the fuzz entry; the library source list includes the changed C files and the entry uses declared public APIs.

input.reason: The entry supplies arbitrary bytes to a server receiver; client magic, initial SETTINGS, and subsequent frames form a finite accepted input.

lifecycle.reason: Under the normal runtime environment, the entry initializes callbacks and a fresh server session, performs one receive and pending sends, then deletes the session. Constructor allocation failures depend on environment failure and are outside the input model.
